'''Mon Gazza system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Lambda sector/Legends|Lambda sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mon Gazza/Legends|Mon Gazza]].
